senses.gloss: (b. h.) to swell, rise; to run over; (cmp. יָתַר, עָדַף) to remain over. Denom. מִשְׁאֶרֶת, שְׁאָר, שְׁאֵר &c.
to be left over, reserved, preserved, spared.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76">Gen. R. s. 76</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 32:9">Gen. XXXII, 9</cite>) <he>אלו אחינו … אע״פ שנִשְׁאֲרוּ לפליטה וכ׳</he> this refers to our brethren in the diaspora …; although they have been spared for escape (from Roman persecution), yet they fasted for us (Palestinians) &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:13:4">Cant. R. to II, 13</cite> <he>הנִשְׁאָרִים</he> the survivors of the Messianic days; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:6">B. Bath. IX, 6</cite> <he>שכיב … וש׳ וכ׳</he> if an ill person donated all his property to others and reserved some land for himself, his donation is valid (even if he recovers).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 148a:4">Ib. 148ᵃ</cite> <he>דקל לאחד וש׳ פירותיו לפניו ש׳ מקום פירי</he> if he donated a palm-tree (for the wood of it) to a person, and reserved its fruit for himself, he meant to reserve for himself the place whereon the fruit grows (the branches).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 148a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כל … בעין יפה מְשַׁיֵּיר</he> whatever one reserves for one’s self, one reserves liberally; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְשׁוֹאָר</he>, <he>(מְשׁוּיָּיר</he>). Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵃ top <he>לא עשה בה המש׳ כיוצא</he> the law does not treat that which is left over (of the sacrifice) like that which has been carried outside of its limits.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:3">Peah III, 3</cite> <he>נותּן מן המש׳ על מה ששייר</he> he must give to the poor out of the remainder in proportion to that which he left over; <he>נותן מן המש׳ על הכל</he> he must give out of the remainder a quantity corresponding to the whole (including that which he has taken out before); a. fr.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite> <he>שלא להַשְׁאִיר זכר וכ׳</he> that he will not leave a remainder of the memory of Amalek; Yalk. ib. 642 <he>להשאר</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>ניטל … ולא נ׳ וכ׳</he> if the liver of a slaughtered animal is found consumed without any part of it left.
<cite ref="Yoma 77a:3">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נִשְׁתַּיְירוּ משונאיהן וכ׳</he> no remnant or survivor would have been left of the enemies of Israel (euphem. for ‘of Israel’); a. fr.
